text:
Maya: Heads-up — we need 6 x A100 (40GB) in eu-west1 for a live demo on Mar 28 09:30 UTC. Low-latency reserved workload for ~2h. Can infra confirm availability and quota? :thinking:

Liam (CloudOps): Checking quotas now. Do we need dedicated reserved nodes or will hosted with preemptibles work? :eyes:

Maya: Prefer dedicated pool to avoid eviction. Demo is customer-facing; can't risk preemptible. Also need GPU driver stack pinned to cuda 11.8.

Liam (CloudOps): Understood. Current project quota for A100s in eu-west1 is 4. I'm opening a request for temporary quota bump to 10. Command I used: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-inference`

Liam (CloudOps): Pasting response:
```
quotas:
 - metric: GPUs (A100)
   limit: 4
   usage: 2
```

Sam - EngInfra: Vendor side — can we get 6 reserved A100s on GCP + regional IPs? @vendor-support any ETA? :pray:

vendor-support: Hi! We can reserve capacity but need a formal PO. For eu-west1 availability we can soft-hold resources for Mar 28 if you confirm by EOD. No guaranteed SLA without commitment. Link: https://vendor.example.com/reservations/12345

Olga - SRE: If PO needed, can we instead spin a short-lived Dedicated pool in our Dedicated offering in eu-west1? That avoids vendor contract but needs infra approvals for spot-less nodes. Suggested config:
```
pool:
  region: eu-west1
  gpus: 6
  type: A100-40GB
  reserved: true
  lifetime: 3h
```

Maya: PO is okay if we get a price. Sam — can you run numbers? Also need CI image with cuda 11.8 and cuDNN pinned.

Sam - EngInfra: Rough estimate: vendor reserved rate ~€X/hr per GPU. I'll pull official quote and ping @Natalie - Finance for temporary spend approval.

Natalie - Finance: Give me the ballpark and I'll approve up to €Y for this demo. Need GL code and cost center.

Sam - EngInfra: GL: INF-DEMOS. Ballpark total ~€Z for the 2h window. I'll attach quote when vendor replies.

vendor-support: Quote attached: reservation id 12345, total estimate €Z for 2 hours incl setup. Please send PO to procure@vendor.example.com.

Maya: OK moving forward with procurement if finance OK. Liam — can you open a ticket to allocate dedicated pool and pin driver? Tag me when done. :thumbsup:

Liam (CloudOps): Created ticket INFRA-789. Assigning to infra oncall. ETA 24h for setup once PO/commit confirmed.

Olga - SRE: I'll prepare a runbook for cutover and a fallback to hosted smaller instances in case of last-minute failure (health checks, traffic switch).

Maya: Thanks all — I'll update demo owners and confirm by EOD.
